pages.text: The $(item)Nether Wild Skyseed$() — a $(item)Wild Skyseed$() carried down into the dark, wrapped in netherrack and a $(item)nether wart$(). The $(bold)adaptive Nether starter$(): the seed to reach for when you just want to see what the local fire-and-fungus grows.
Everything's in hand — here's how it goes together.

Like its overworld cousin it $(bold)becomes the land it lands on$() — but over the $(bold)Nether$() map: a crimson forest grows the $(item)Nether Forest$() isle, a warped one its teal twin, a soul sand valley the $(item)Nether Soul$() isle, the basalt deltas the $(item)Nether Basalt$() isle, and the open wastes a plain $(item)Nether Rocky$() mining rock.

$(bold)A lucky find$()$(br)As with the overworld Wild, a build is a $(bold)surprise$(), not a promise — only the larger isles carry the odd blaze room or bastion remnant. For a guaranteed full-size island, craft one of the dedicated Nether seeds instead.
